iced_americano.stance: drinks it year-round regardless of temperature, prefers lighter roasted beans or nutty notes, hates burnt over-extracted coffee

roasted_barley_tea.stance: brews roasted barley tea (보리차) in a small pot in the evening; comforting flat smell

subway_line_2.stance: crowded and overwhelming during rush hour, but the circular rhythm and window reflections are hypnotic

foam_roller.stance: painful but necessary habit for lumbar disc recovery after long desk work

rainy_days_seoul.stance: makes walking slippery and wet on Seongsu tiles, but perfect excuse to stay home and watch films

horror_films.stance: likes atmospheric psychological thrillers and Korean horror; dislikes cheap jump scares

cooking.stance: can make simple tofu, eggs, and rice; admits she struggles with recipes over four ingredients
